seo.featuresSubtitle: AI contract reader that scans every clause for unusual terms, missing sections, and noteworthy details — explained in plain language you can act on.
seo.reviewFeature1Desc: AI scans every clause for unusual terms, missing sections, and noteworthy details.
seo.reviewFeature2Desc: Auto-detects document region and applies the right context (US, EU, UK, China, etc.)
seo.reviewFeature3Desc: Get ready-to-use suggestions: what to consider, how to respond, and options to explore.
seo.reviewFeature4Desc: No complex terminology. We explain every clause in language you understand.
seo.reviewFeature5Desc: Upload a document and get a full overview in under a minute.
seo.reviewFeature6Desc: Your document files are processed in memory only — never stored on our servers.
seo.compareFeature1Desc: AI compares two document versions and highlights every modification, addition, and deletion.
seo.compareFeature2Desc: Catches wording changes — when wording shifts but meaning stays different.
seo.compareFeature3Desc: Each change is labeled: improved, worsened, or unchanged for you.
seo.compareFeature4Desc: See old text vs new text in a clean, organized layout.
seo.scenariosSubtitle: From freelance agreements to investment deals — SpotClause helps you read documents across every industry and region.
seo.scenario1Desc: Verify payment terms, IP ownership, and termination rights before signing client agreements.
seo.scenario2Desc: Check non-compete clauses, working hours, and probation periods for alignment with standard practice.
seo.scenario3Desc: Avoid overly broad confidentiality scope, perpetual obligations, and one-sided terms.
seo.scenario4Desc: Understand data ownership, SLA terms, and liability limits for technology agreements.
seo.scenario5Desc: Review rent escalation clauses, repair responsibilities, and deposit terms.
seo.scenario6Desc: Catch notable valuation adjustments, liquidation preferences, and control terms.
seo.howitSubtitle: Upload any document, get a full overview with suggestions in under 60 seconds. No legal background needed.
seo.step1Desc: Drag and drop your PDF, Word, or image file (up to 20MB).
seo.step2Desc: Our AI parses every clause, matches document patterns, and highlights key sections.
seo.step3Desc: Document score, clause-by-clause summary, and insights in plain English.
seo.faqSubtitle: Learn how SpotClause keeps your data safe, what documents we support, and how our AI delivers helpful results.
seo.faq1A: Yes. Document files are processed in memory and never saved to our servers. Only the analysis report is stored in your account.
seo.faq2Q: What languages and regions are supported?
seo.faq2A: We support 14+ languages and auto-detect the document region (US, EU, UK, China, Japan, and more) to apply the right context.
seo.faq3Q: How helpful is the AI reading?
seo.faq3A: Our AI uses a curated pattern library to highlight items in documents. However, it is an informational tool only and does not provide professional advice for high-stakes deals.
seo.faq4Q: Can I try it for free?
seo.faq4A: Yes — every account gets one free document reading (1MB file size limit). Paid plans start at $12.90/month for 10 readings.
seo.ctaSubtitle: Sign up free — no credit card required.
